description: Shared Renovate preset: keeps the lint, format, git-hook and compiler tooling on the same versions in every TraceBIM-CE repo. Repos extend it as github>ebalzan/tracebim-ci//renovate/tooling#v1.

packageRules.description: Only the shared tooling below is managed; every other dependency (framework, runtime, GitHub Actions) stays manual.
One PR per repo for the shared tooling (majors get their own PR). chore keeps the branch type and the PR title in step for pr-title.
typescript-eslint (direct in tracebim-api, through eslint-config-next and eslint-config-expo elsewhere) only supports typescript <6.1. Raise this once it does.
